answer_1.quote: We propose a novel Hierarchical Variational Auto-Encoder (HVAE) model to tackle sentiment drift problem.

answer_2.quote: Extensive experimental results on real‑world data demonstrate our proposed model is significantly better than state‑of‑the‑arts for sentiment drift detection.
